#DOT Market Analysis

DOT is at 1.122 on the 4h, snapping back hard after a brief wick below the rising trendline from the late August lows got reclaimed in one strong green candle. That’s the third test of the trendline this month, and buyers have defended it every time.

Bull case: clear 1.160 and push toward 1.200, opening a path back to the 1.250 to 1.300 highs.
Bear case: lose 1.080 and break the trendline for real, exposing 1.000 and the 0.930 September lows.

Third trendline defense sets up the next leg, or is support running out of steam?

#BTC Market Analysis

BTC is at 81,953.21 on the 4h, squeezing deeper into a large triangle between the rising trendline from the mid September lows and the descending trendline from the 87,400 highs. The latest bounce off support near 80,900 stalled around 82,800, so price is stuck in the lower half of the pattern for now.

Bull case: clear 82,800 and reclaim 84,000, opening a path toward the descending trendline near 86,000.
Bear case: lose the rising trendline near 80,900, exposing 80,000 and a deeper drop toward 78,000.

Triangle support holds for a push higher, or is a breakdown loading?

Bitcoin Bullets® Trading

Altcoin leverage is still running hot.

Prices have pulled back since leverage peaked earlier this month, yet over 40% of large caps still sit near their highest leverage of the year. In mid caps, that share is at a yearly high.

A deeper drop would put many longs at risk.

Short-term profit-taking has weighed on $BTC.

Two weeks ago we flagged short-term holders in profit sending the largest share of exchange inflows in a year. This selling has weighed on price since.

The flow has now eased back to its average yearly level.
